sonnet.problem: The blank asks for "every" in "abstain from ___ form of evil." Nothing earlier lets the baker reason out this exact word. The baker can only guess the wording of the verse, and "the worst" and "the obvious" would fit the sentence just as well.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks for "coming" in "kept blameless at the ___ of our Lord Jesus Christ." No earlier card tells that part of verse 23 or sets up the idea of Christ's coming. The baker can only guess the wording of the line, and this card's own wrong answers "word" and "throne" are equally plausible fillers.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
